summary: Completed testing of new slot management features (iteration 6). All 14 backend API tests passed (100%). All frontend UI tests passed. Features tested: building creation with custom slot_prefix, floor creation with slot_labels/slot_prefix, bulk slot addition, inline slot rename, slot delete.

issues: Console warnings: Chart width/height -1 errors - recharts library issue with container sizing, not a blocker (known issue from previous iterations)

Floor creation supports both slot_labels (custom labels) and slot_prefix (auto-generate)

All interactive elements have appropriate data-testid attributes
seed_data_creation: Test buildings created during backend tests were cleaned up automatically via pytest fixtures
